Long Stem Rose of Balzack's Everlasting Tango
Piece:  Weapon
Type:  Two-handed Staff
Class:  Mage
Damage:  varies with item level

Long Stem Rose of Balzack's Everlasting Tango is a mage two-handed staff.

This rainbow is specific to Balzack's lair chest. It is not in the shared mythic pool every boss rolls. The Wishing Well can also spit it out once you are high enough for that dungeon. The full list is on Boss Lair Rainbows.

Attributes:

The base item always carries:

  • + Poison Damage
  • + Total Mana
  • + Intellect
  • + Mana Steal

Rolled copies can also pick up an extra ending. Those endings and their bonuses are listed on Mythic Suffixes.
